info.name: JANUS.SEARCH — GitHub Issues Ingress
info.description: Live first-free bounded JANUS.SEARCH over the GitHub Issues REST API. The caller supplies its own GitHub credential. This collection describes the deployed GitHub Issues transport only; it is not a general JANUS transaction API and does not claim live MCP, A2A, or x402 seller runtimes.

request.description: Creates one bounded public JANUS.SEARCH request. Exactly one first new SEARCH order is free per external GitHub principal. The external caller must use its own GitHub credential. Owner/self traffic does not qualify as a foreign-agent witness.
Reads issue comments for the request. The reconciled JANUS result is returned on this public issue surface.
